issue.title: gateway/antigravity: union type ["string","array"] keeps items but collapses to string — Gemini 400 on tool schema
issue.body:
## Summary

A Codex Desktop conversation routed through magpie to an Antigravity account fails before generation when an MCP tool declares a parameter as a JSON Schema type **union** that combines `string` and `array` while also defining `items`.

Observed error:

```text
Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[23].parameters.properties[disease].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[23].parameters.properties[drug].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
```

HTTP 400, deterministic on every turn that includes the tool. The same tool set works fine through OpenAI-compatible providers on the same gateway.

## Environment

- Client: Codex Desktop, agent `codex@wsl:Ubuntu-22.04`
- Route: Codex → magpie gateway → Antigravity subscription (`gemini-3.8-flash`)
- magpie: `0.1.1306` (Windows)
- Observed: 2026-10-21
- MCP server: `biomcp` 0.9.3 (`biomcp serve`), tool `search`

## Minimal schema shape

The `search` tool declares `disease` and `drug` as:

```json
{
  "disease": {
    "type": ["string", "array"],
    "items": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 256 },
    "minItems": 1,
    "maxItems": 3,
    "minLength": 1,
    "maxLength": 256,
    "uniqueItems": true
  }
}
```

This is valid JSON Schema: the parameter accepts either a single string or an array of strings.

## Root cause

`plainSchema()` in `internal/gateway/codeassist.go` folds the `type` list like this:

```go
case "type":
    if ts, ok := v.([]any); ok {
        for _, t := range ts {
            if t == "null" {
                out["nullable"] = true
            } else if out["type"] == nil {
                out["type"] = t
            }
        }
    }
```

The first non-`null` member wins, so `["string", "array"]` collapses to `type: "string"`. Meanwhile `case "items"` copies `items` through verbatim. The emitted schema is:

```json
{ "type": "string", "items": { ... }, "minItems": 1, "maxItems": 3, "uniqueItems": true }
```

`uniqueItems` is dropped (outside the subset), but `items`, `minItems`, and `maxItems` all survive on a non-array type — and Antigravity's `Schema.items` predicate requires `$type == Type.ARRAY`, hence the 400.

This is the mirror image of #2784 / #2826 (array schemas missing `items`); here it is `items` surviving on a non-array type.

## Proposed fix

When `type` is a list, pick the member consistent with the schema's sibling keywords rather than blindly taking the first non-null entry. Minimal rule covering this case: if `x["items"] != nil` (or `minItems` / `maxItems` / `uniqueItems` present) and the list contains `"array"`, select `"array"`. Symmetrically, if the chosen type ends up non-array, drop `items`/`minItems`/`maxItems`/`uniqueItems` so the emitted schema stays self-consistent — Gemini validates `items` only against `type`, so either choice unblocks the request.

comments.body: Found the same root cause from #3173 (a 309-tool MCP set whose `items` sit under `oneOf`): it isn't the union branch — `plainSchema` folds oneOf/anyOf correctly — it is that a schema typed as a **list** of types keeps its `items` after the fold: `{"type":["string","array"],"items":{…}}` collapses to `{"type":"string","items":{…}}`, the exact shape Gemini's `$type == Type.ARRAY` predicate refuses, and in #3173's case one nesting deeper (`items.items`). Branch with the fix (one `delete(out, "items")` where the fold lands, with a test): [hunt57-b-antigravity-items](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/hunt57-b-antigravity-items) (head `b7a40951`), patch and verification on [#3173](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3173#issuecomment-6316205998).

修了，在分支 [skygunner:fix/union-items](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/union-items)（commit c638203，基于 main 87d703c5）。README 说本仓库不开 PR，放在这里供取用。

按你提出的两条一起做（`plainSchema` 尾部加一段一致性整理）：

- 折叠后的类型不是 array、但 schema 带 items/minItems/maxItems 时：type 联合里有 array 半边就取 array（你的 `disease`/`drug` 参数场景——保留更具体的那半边，minItems/maxItems 约束不丢）；联合里没有 array 半边（或根本不是联合）就删掉 items/minItems/maxItems，发出去的 schema 自洽。
- 触发条件用「items/minItems/maxItems 存在」而不是只看 items，覆盖你建议的最小规则并对称处理。

**验证**（`GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.8`、`umask 022`；commit body 有完整记录）

- 新增 `TestPlainSchemaUnionBesideItemsKeepsTheArrayHalf`：改动前红——你贴的 disease 参数原样进来，输出正是 400 的形状 `{"type":"string","items":…}`；改动后绿——type=array、items/minItems/maxItems 保留；对照组 [`string`,`null`] 联合带 items 保持 string 并丢掉 items。
- `TestPlainSchemaKeepsOnlyWhatAntigravityTakes` 与 internal/gateway 其余测试通过（包内仅 #3280 为 main 既有红）；三平台 vet/build 通过；全量 67 ok（除 #2207、#3280 外无新增红）。
- 没有对真实 Antigravity/biomcp 试过；schema 字节取自你的 issue。

Verified skygunner's branch (`fix/union-items`, commit `c638203`, based on main `87d703c5`) against both this issue's shape and #3173's. It is red without the change, green with it, and its behavior supersedes my minimal branch everywhere the two differ.

| Shape | my minimal branch (b7a40951, from the #3173 thread) | fix/union-items (c638203) |
|---|---|---|
| `["string","array"]` beside items (this issue's disease/drug) | folds to string, drops items — legal, but loses the array half and its bounds | takes the array half, keeps items/minItems/maxItems |
| #3173's minimal union-on-items forms | folds to the first member, typed | same — my test passes on their branch verbatim |
| a union beside items nested under items (the `items.items` path) | folds to string, drops the inner items — legal | takes the inner array half — legal, and closer to what the tool declared |
| non-union `{"type":"string","items":…}` | drops items | drops items |
| `["string","null"]` beside items | keeps string/nullable, drops items | same (their control case) |
| bare `minItems`/`maxItems` on a non-array, no items | left in place | dropped |

Their pass supersedes my minimal branch: everywhere mine deletes, theirs deletes identically or keeps a legal array half, and it alone cleans the bare-bounds case. My branch stays as the minimal fallback — nothing further from me on this one.

One more thing worth recording: their branch also covers #3173's shapes (verified above). #3173 was closed by its reporter pointing at my fork branch, but neither fix is in main, so landing this one covers both issues.

Local Go is go1.26.8 — the version their commit message pins — so the runs below are directly comparable.

| Check | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Red without the fix | `git checkout 87d703c5 -- internal/gateway/codeassist.go` (their parent), keep their new test, `go test -tags nogui -count=1 -run TestPlainSchemaUnionBesideItemsKeepsTheArrayHalf ./internal/gateway/` | FAIL — got `{"type":"string","items":{…},"minItems":1,"maxItems":3,…}`, the exact 400 shape |
| Restored | same command after `git checkout HEAD -- internal/gateway/codeassist.go` | ok, exit 0 |
| #3173 shapes on their branch | throwaway test (deleted after the run) feeding every schema shape from #3121 and #3173 through `plainSchema` and failing on any items/minItems/maxItems found on a non-array type | PASS — every array keyword rides on `"type":"array"`, including the bare minItems/maxItems case |
| My tests on top of their branch | b7a40951's test functions overlaid verbatim | `TestPlainSchemaFoldsAUnionOnItems` PASS; `TestPlainSchemaDropsItemsOffAnArray` fails only where their output is the legal array half — the expected superset difference, no illegal node in any output |
| Package | `go test -tags nogui -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/gateway/` | ok, 339.7s — all green on this box; the #3280 red did not reproduce here |
| Race | `go test -tags nogui -race -count=1 -run TestPlainSchema ./internal/gateway/` | ok |
| Vet ×3 | `go vet -tags nogui ./internal/gateway` — darwin/arm64, GOOS=linux, GOOS=windows | clean, exit 0 |
| Build ×3 | `go build -tags nogui ./...` — same three | exit 0 (one pre-existing cgo `-Wenum-conversion` warning in internal/gui, a file the patch doesn't touch) |
| gofmt | `gofmt -l internal/gateway/codeassist.go internal/gateway/plain_schema_test.go` | clean |
| Applies to current main | `git diff 87d703c5 95be6bb7 -- internal/gateway/codeassist.go internal/gateway/plain_schema_test.go`; `git merge-tree` | no drift between their base and the current tip; merges clean |

One nit, non-blocking: the new test's comment credits rgoliveira; this issue is MurmuredVelpro's (the commit message has it right).

Verified with AI assistance (GLM-5.3-Flash via ZCode); I've read the diff and re-ran the checks above.

**Update for current main**: the shapes this branch (and my minimal branch from the first comment) were written for are covered on main itself now — `d71362afc` (Oct 27, "a Gemini tool schema with items is an array, not its enum's string, and Antigravity gets items only on arrays", ferock's report via Discord) landed both halves in `plainSchema`:

- the type-list fold now takes the half its `items` or `properties` are for, so `["string","array"]` beside `items` folds to `array` with the bounds kept (`internal/gateway/codeassist.go:951` on `3bebc383`);
- and the walk's single exit drops `items`/`minItems`/`maxItems` from any node whose final type isn't `array` (`internal/gateway/codeassist.go:1026`).

Re-verified on `3bebc383` with a throwaway probe (not committed) that walks the whole folded schema and fails if any `items`/`minItems`/`maxItems` is left on a non-array:

| Shape | only `codeassist.go` reverted to `d71362afc^` | current main |
|---|---|---|
| `["string","array"]` beside `items`, one level (this issue's `disease`) | `{"type":"string","items":…}` — the reported 400 shape | folds to `array`, `items` kept |
| nested `items.items`, inner node a type list (`#3173`'s 400 path) | `items.items` on a string — stray | inner node comes out `array` |
| `["string","number"]` beside `items` (no array half), plus bare `minItems`/`maxItems` | all three left on the string | all three dropped, plain `string` |

All three are red on the reverted file, green on main; the package's own plain-schema tests pass both ways. So for current main the branch here is superseded — the comparison table in my comment above now reads the same from maintainer code. Nothing further needed unless a shape shows up that main still folds wrong.

issue.title: gateway/antigravity: `items` 为 oneOf/anyOf 联合类型（无 type）时 Gemini 400 —— plainSchema 未兜底 items

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 概述

Codex 经 magpie 转发到 Antigravity（`gemini-3.8-flash`）时，只要 MCP 工具的参数里有 **`items` 是 `oneOf` / `anyOf` 联合类型（无 `type` 字段）**，Antigravity 就返回 400，整个回合失败。

同一个工具集走 OpenAI 兼容 / DeepSeek / GPT 等上游都正常，只有 Antigravity 拒绝。

## 报错

```text
400: Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[67].parameters.properties[functions].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[68].parameters.properties[reviewed_obligations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[70].parameters.properties[secrets].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[70].parameters.properties[actions].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[81].parameters.properties[left_native_observations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[81].parameters.properties[right_native_observations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[92].parameters.properties[static_comparisons].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[92].parameters.properties[runtime_comparisons].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[92].parameters.properties[mappings].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[109].parameters.properties[comparisons].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[122].parameters.properties[notes].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[122].parameters.properties[methods].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[211].parameters.properties[inventory_evidence].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[212].parameters.properties[inventory_evidence].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[213].parameters.properties[inventory_evidence].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[222].parameters.properties[static_layers].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[222].parameters.properties[runtime_observations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[247].parameters.properties[native_observations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
* GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[260].parameters.properties[native_observations].items.items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
```

确定性失败：同一回合里每次重试都是同样的 400，不是账号或配额问题。

## 环境

- 客户端：Codex Desktop，agent `codex`
- 路由：Codex → magpie gateway → Antigravity（`gemini-3.8-flash`，effort high）
- magpie：`0.1.1306`（Windows），升级后 `0.1.1308` 现象相同
- 观测时间：2026-10-21 17:07 起
- MCP server：REA（逆向工程工具集，`mcp__rea__*`，共 309 个工具）
- 失败回合：24-27、33-80，共 54 次连续失败

## 最小 schema 形态

`mcp__rea__build_call_path` 的 `functions` 参数：

```json
{
  "functions": {
    "minItems": 1,
    "type": "array",
    "items": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "subject": {
          "anyOf": [
            { "oneOf": [ { "type": "object", "properties": { ... } } ] },
            { "type": "string" }
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

`mcp__rea__capture_browser_scenario` 的 `actions` 参数：

```json
{
  "actions": {
    "minItems": 1,
    "type": "array",
    "items": {
      "oneOf": [
        { "type": "object", "properties": { "step_id": {...}, "kind": {...} }, "required": [...] },
        { "type": "object", "properties": { ... } }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

关键：**`items` 本身没有 `type` 字段，只有 `oneOf` / `anyOf`。**

## 根因

`plainSchema()`（`internal/gateway/codeassist.go`）把 schema 裁到 Antigravity 接受的 OpenAPI 子集时，会丢掉 `oneOf` / `anyOf`，但**保留了外层的 `type: "array"` 和 `items`**。

结果发出的是：

```json
{ "type": "array", "items": {} }
```

或 `items` 变成空对象 / 只剩 `properties`，**没有 `type: "array"`**。

Antigravity 的 `Schema.items` 前置校验要求 `$type == Type.ARRAY`，于是报 `field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY`。

这和我之前报的 #3121 / #2784 / #2826 是同一处 `plainSchema` 归一化边界的三种形态：

| Issue | schema 形态 |
|---|---|
| #2784 / #2826 | `type: "array"` 但缺 `items` |
| #3121 | `type: ["string","array"]` 折叠成 `string` 但留着 `items` |
| **本条** | **`items` 是 `oneOf`/`anyOf`，无 `type`** |

## 受影响范围

同一会话 309 个工具里，**32 个**含 `items` 联合类型：

```
mcp__rea__build_call_path
mcp__rea__build_reconstruction_obligation_ledger
mcp__rea__capture_browser_scenario
mcp__rea__capture_electron_scenario
mcp__rea__capture_native_ui_scenario
mcp__rea__compare_application_versions
mcp__rea__compare_artifacts
mcp__rea__compare_bundles
mcp__rea__compare_functions
mcp__rea__correlate_static_and_runtime
mcp__rea__find_changed_behavior
mcp__rea__import_managed_reconstruction
mcp__rea__project_android_application_graph
mcp__rea__project_apple_application_graph
mcp__rea__project_harmony_application_graph
mcp__rea__reconcile_javascript_runtime
mcp__rea__trace_application_feature
mcp__rea__verify_managed_native_reconstruction
mcp__rea__verify_reconstruction
mcp__rea__verify_managed_native_boundaries
... （共 32 个）
```

## 建议修复

在 `plainSchema()` 里补一条 `items` 兜底：**`items` 裁完 `oneOf` / `anyOf` 后若没有 `type`，就按第一个分支的 `type` 补上；若所有分支都是 `object`，就取 `{ "type": "object" }`；否则退化为 `{ "type": "string" }`。**

和 #2826 提的 `ensureArrayItems` 可以合并成一次遍历：

```go
// 伪代码
if node["type"] == "array" {
    it := node["items"]
    if it == nil || it["type"] == nil {
        // 从 oneOf/anyOf 的第一支取 type，取不到就 string
        node["items"] = map[string]any{"type": inferType(it)}
    }
}
```

## 附带发现（和 #2784 评论同一个问题）

这个 400 出现时，magpie **没有**把请求交给路由组的下一个成员，整个回合直接断了。

- 路由组：`group/vibe-coding`
- 13 条失败路由全部 `antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash`，全部 400，全部 0 token 计费
- 每一次都是 `handed_on: false`

`order` 路由下 400 应该算可 fallback 的错误，但它被当成终止性错误了。

## 临时规避

在 DSH / Codex 侧对 Antigravity 禁用含联合类型 schema 的 MCP server，或把 Antigravity 从路由组里摘掉。

issue.title: [Bug] Antigravity 适配层透传 JSON Schema 联合类型 type:["object","array"] + items，Google 严格校验必 400（带最小复现）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 环境
- magpie `0.1.1323`（macOS 27.0，Apple Silicon，桌面 App + gateway :3425）
- 客户端：Codex CLI（经 Magpie gateway，`group/cap-route` → compact 规则改派 `group/fast`，首跳 `antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash`）
- Antigravity 账号已登录，普通请求一切正常

## 现象（确定性，非偶发）
Codex 的**远端压缩请求（remote compaction）携带工具 schema** 发到 Magpie，经 Antigravity 适配层翻译后，Google 返回 400，整轮作废：

```
Antigravity: * GenerateContentRequest.tools[0].function_declarations[0].parameters.properties[params].items: field predicate failed: $type == Type.ARRAY
```

## 根因
工具的某个参数（本例是 codex_apps 桥接的 MCP 工具，参数名 `params`）用了**合法的 OpenAI/JSON Schema 联合类型**：

```json
{
  "type": ["object", "array"],
  "description": "Tool params as a real JSON object (an array for the handful of array-body tools) ...",
  "items": { "type": "string" },
  "properties": {}
}
```

Magpie 的 Antigravity 适配层（OpenAI→Gemini 翻译）把联合类型**原样透传**了。Google 的 Schema proto 是严格校验：`items` 字段存在时 `type` 必须恰好是 `Type.ARRAY`（单值），联合类型直接判死。

## 最小复现（同通道三发对照，本机实测）

对 `http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/chat/completions` 发 `model: antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash`，tools 里放一个 function，其 `parameters.properties.params` 分别用三种 schema：

| 实验 | `params` 的 schema | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| A | `{"type":["object","array"],"items":{"type":"string"},"properties":{}}` | **HTTP 400**，报错与线上失败逐字一致 |
| B | `{"type":"object","properties":{}}` | ✅ HTTP 200 |
| C | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}` | ✅ HTTP 200 |

复现脚本（A 例）：

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/chat/completions   -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer magpie"   -d '{
    "model": "antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash",
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"回复OK"}],
    "max_tokens": 10,
    "tools": [{
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "test_tool",
        "description": "probe",
        "parameters": {"type":"object","properties":{"params":{"type":["object","array"],"description":"Tool params","items":{"type":"string"},"properties":{}}},"required":[]}
      }
    }]
  }'
```

同一通道、同一账号：干净 schema 秒过，联合类型必炸 ⇒ 问题在翻译层，不在 Antigravity 账号或网络。

## 影响
- 触发条件隐蔽：只有当请求**带工具**且某工具参数用了联合类型时才 400。日常小请求不带工具，所以看起来"偶发"。
- 杀伤大：Codex remote compaction 请求天然带全套工具 schema，命中即整轮作废（实测一次白跑 2598 秒）。路由日志一天 274 条 compact 里 124 条带 tools，只要这批工具里有联合类型参数就可能炸。
- 其他 Gemini 系 provider 若走同一翻译层，可能同样受影响。

## 期望修复
翻译为 Gemini Schema 时做一次规范化（normalization），例如：
- 联合类型 `["object","array"]` → 取第一个非 array 类型（`object`），或拆成 `anyOf` 前先剥掉 Google 不认的字段；
- `items` 仅在 `type == "array"`（单值）时保留，否则丢弃；
- 顺带可考虑 `additionalProperties` / `anyOf` 等 Google proto 不支持字段的通用降级。

## 规避（临时）
路由组里把 `antigravity/*` 从会接收带工具请求的组（如 compact 改派目标 `group/fast`）的**首位**挪走，让带工具的请求首跳到能正确翻译的 provider。

issue.title: gateway/antigravity: root oneOf discards object schema and causes Claude 400

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

A valid tool schema whose root has `type: "object"`, `properties`, and a sibling `oneOf` for field-presence constraints is converted into a **string schema with no properties** when sent to Antigravity. A Claude request offering that tool can then fail with HTTP 400 before the model generates anything.

A Philo user observed this error through the OpenAI Chat Completions route:

```text
chat completions request failed: 400 Bad Request
Antigravity: {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"tools.4.custom.input_schema.type: Input should be 'object'"},"request_id":"[redacted]"}
```

The failed live request's outbound tool payload was not captured. In Philo's default tool order, index 4 is `rg`, whose schema has the shape below; the index may differ if the tool list changes. The local reproduction below confirms the conversion defect, but is not a live-upstream replay of that particular request.

## Environment

- Client: Philo, using OpenAI Chat Completions through magpie to an Antigravity Claude model
- Platform: macOS, arm64
- The initial investigation was on magpie `v0.1.1577`. Reproduced locally again on source revision `0b99b8fbe`; the Antigravity converter in installed `v0.1.1871` (`a5315c70d`) is identical to that source.
- The local reproduction uses no account, API credentials, or network request.

## Minimal reproduction

Add this test to a `_test.go` file in `internal/gateway`, then run:

```sh
go test ./internal/gateway -run '^TestAntigravityRootOneOfKeepsObject$' -count=1 -v
```

```go
package gateway

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "testing"
)

func TestAntigravityRootOneOfKeepsObject(t *testing.T) {
    schema := `{"type":"object","properties":{"pattern":{"type":"string"},"cursor":{"type":"string"}},"oneOf":[{"required":["pattern"],"not":{"required":["cursor"]}},{"required":["cursor"],"not":{"required":["pattern"]}}]}`
    got := plainSchema(json.RawMessage(schema))
    var parameters map[string]any
    if err := json.Unmarshal(got, &parameters); err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    props, _ := parameters["properties"].(map[string]any)
    if parameters["type"] != "object" || props["pattern"] == nil || props["cursor"] == nil {
        t.Fatalf("got %s; want an object retaining pattern and cursor", got)
    }
}
```

**Actual:** the test fails with `got {"type":"string"}; want an object retaining pattern and cursor`. I also reproduced the same `parameters: {"type":"string"}` via `parseChat` → `buildCodeAssist(..., "antigravity")` using an OpenAI Chat tool declaration.

**Expected:** the converted function parameters retain an object root and both declared properties. If Antigravity cannot represent the root `oneOf`, its presence-only constraint can be relaxed in the provider-facing schema while the client keeps the original schema for local validation; it should not replace the entire object with a string.

## Suspected cause

`buildCodeAssist` passes Antigravity tool parameters through `plainSchema` in [`internal/gateway/codeassist.go`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/a5315c70d5f3d2062af5135d6c4deaeef0a097d9/internal/gateway/codeassist.go). The `anyOf`/`oneOf` branch walks the first non-null alternative and returns that result, discarding sibling keywords on the original schema. Here the first alternative only contains `required`/`not`, so the resulting schema has no inferred type and falls back to `"string"`.

A fix could preserve the object root and declared properties when projecting this presence-constraint shape. Other kinds of unions may need separate handling rather than being unconditionally flattened. This is distinct from #3121, which concerns an array/string type list and `items` on a nested property.

timeline.body:
**Update for current main**: the shapes this branch (and my minimal branch from the first comment) were written for are covered on main itself now — `d71362afc` (Oct 27, "a Gemini tool schema with items is an array, not its enum's string, and Antigravity gets items only on arrays", ferock's report via Discord) landed both halves in `plainSchema`:

- the type-list fold now takes the half its `items` or `properties` are for, so `["string","array"]` beside `items` folds to `array` with the bounds kept (`internal/gateway/codeassist.go:951` on `3bebc383`);
- and the walk's single exit drops `items`/`minItems`/`maxItems` from any node whose final type isn't `array` (`internal/gateway/codeassist.go:1026`).

Re-verified on `3bebc383` with a throwaway probe (not committed) that walks the whole folded schema and fails if any `items`/`minItems`/`maxItems` is left on a non-array:

| Shape | only `codeassist.go` reverted to `d71362afc^` | current main |
|---|---|---|
| `["string","array"]` beside `items`, one level (this issue's `disease`) | `{"type":"string","items":…}` — the reported 400 shape | folds to `array`, `items` kept |
| nested `items.items`, inner node a type list (`#3173`'s 400 path) | `items.items` on a string — stray | inner node comes out `array` |
| `["string","number"]` beside `items` (no array half), plus bare `minItems`/`maxItems` | all three left on the string | all three dropped, plain `string` |

All three are red on the reverted file, green on main; the package's own plain-schema tests pass both ways. So for current main the branch here is superseded — the comparison table in my comment above now reads the same from maintainer code. Nothing further needed unless a shape shows up that main still folds wrong.
